decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher close to the core portfolio costs little to keep listed as a traded item, and its prospects are still unresolved after one year.
The UV spot varnishing system is a flagship whose German premiere was only in August 2023, so its uncertain upside in enhancement makes the option worth keeping.
The sheet preparation module builds on existing systems and is cheap to carry, though as a minor add-on it could be quietly retired if the partner updates its range.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship launched in March 2023 that fits the firm's automation direction, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The hybrid saddle stitcher sits close to the core booklet-making business and has low carrying cost for a wholesaler, so the option remains open.
The folding add-on unit already shows a real customer installation running one-pass workflows, which is positive evidence and a reason to keep it.
